plugin.note: Ents have a 40% weakness to fire spells, so fire magic is fastest; their ranged defence (+30) is their lowest, making ranged a good alternative. Their melee defences (slash/crush +70) are high, so avoid melee. Bring a hatchet to chop the defeated trunks for noted logs.

requirements: Kills must be made in the Wilderness to count for the Krystilia assignment.
No Slayer level or quest requirement.
A hatchet matching your Woodcutting level is useful to chop the defeated trunks for noted logs.
mechanics: The Wilderness ent (npc 6594) is combat level 101 with 105 Hitpoints and grants 107.5 Slayer XP.
It attacks with crush melee at a 4-tick speed.
It has a 40% weakness to fire spells (added June 2025); defence level 75 with ranged its weakest defence (+30).
After the ent is defeated its trunk can be chopped for noted logs.

methods.label: Fire magic
methods.summary: Exploit the 40% fire weakness with fire spells against the Chaos Temple ents.
steps: Travel to the ents near the Chaos Temple in the Wilderness.
Attack with fire spells to exploit the 40% weakness.
Chop each defeated trunk with a hatchet for noted logs.

methods.label: Ranged
methods.summary: Use ranged against the ent's low ranged defence (+30).
steps: Chop each defeated trunk for noted logs.
